reuse.why: The recurring-holiday rule is added behind the existing isOffDay predicate that every holiday-aware path already calls, so all consumers pick it up.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; the only wart is that the occurrence-padding heuristic, already repeated in three places, is changed in just one of them with a new ad hoc formula.

placement.why: The new isHoliday helper sits next to isOffDay in shared/schedules.ts, the module that owns weekend/holiday rules.

scope.why: Focused on the holiday match plus a test; the unexplained change to the take padding in getUpcomingDates is a small extra edit.

maintainability.why: Clear, documented single predicate; the magic padding formula (Math.ceil(count / 200) + 1) is uncommented and diverges from the other padding sites.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks continue to go through isOffDay.
